question: A person is running with a speed of 15 km/h. How much distance he will cover in 7 minutes?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the speed directly into meters per minute to save time.

Speed = 15 km/h = (15 × 1000) ÷ 60 m/min = 250 m/min.

Distance covered in 7 minutes = Speed × Time.

Distance = 250 × 7 = 1750 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 1750 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the person = 15 km/h

Time taken = 7 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

1 km/h = 5/18 m/s

 
• 
 
 
 Start
 End
 Speed = 15 km/h
 Time = 7 min
 Distance = ?
 

 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Convert speed into m/s:

⇒ Speed = 15 × (5 / 18) = 75 / 18 = 25 / 6 m/s

⇒ Convert time into seconds:

⇒ Time = 7 × 60 = 420 seconds

⇒ Calculate distance:

⇒ Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Distance = (25 / 6) × 420

⇒ Distance = 25 × 70

⇒ Distance = 1750 m

**∴ The correct answer is 1750 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion Trick

To convert km/h to m/s quickly, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s back to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed

When traveling equal distances at speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy / (x + y). For unequal distances, use Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, relative speed is (S₁ − S₂). When moving in opposite directions, it is (S₁ + S₂).
